name: BlastForge
detailed_description:
Step into the high-stakes world of BlastForge, where precision, strategy, and skill come together in a thrilling artillery shooting simulator. Get ready to engage in intense, fast-paced combat where every shot counts. Whether you're a novice or a seasoned sharpshooter, this game challenges you to perfect your aim and become a true artillery master.

Realistic Ballistics:
In BlastForge, every shot is a test of your understanding of physics. You'll need to account for projectile trajectory, range, target speed, and environmental factors like wind and visibility. The closer your calculations, the more accurate your shots will be, making every successful hit feel incredibly rewarding.

Intuitive Gameplay:
Whether you’re manually adjusting your aim or using the assist features, BlastForge offers gameplay that suits every skill level. You can take full control, aiming with precise calculations, or use helpful guides to adjust for lead and elevation, allowing you to gradually master the complexities of artillery shooting.

Varied Difficulty Modes:
No matter your experience, BlastForge has a mode for you. Start with training, where hints guide your every move, and progress to harder levels that leave you with no assistance at all. For those who seek a real challenge, the hardcore mode will put your precision and calculation abilities to the ultimate test.

Diverse Locations & Real Combat Scenarios:
Battle through dynamic environments, from serene mountain ranges to stormy battlefields. Each location presents new challenges, as changing weather conditions affect your visibility and the speed of your projectiles. You'll need to adapt to the ever-shifting conditions to land those perfect shots.

Progression System:
As you progress, unlock new artillery, more powerful shells, and upgrades to fine-tune your combat capabilities. Perfect your skills and master every artillery weapon, making each shot more effective than the last.

Are you ready to test your artillery skills? In BlastForge, precision and tactical thinking are your keys to victory. Load your cannon, aim with precision, and destroy your targets before they vanish into the distance.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad Core Intel i5 or AMD equivalent 4 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
